name: Acceptance add-ons
description: The acceptance run's plugin with add-ons of its own: stamps, small JSON files in its data folder's addons/, each a word it stamps on a text. It runs one only once its hash is trusted, after the user's yes to its own question card. Its status-bar button asks the user through its own question card from its component.

addons.description: Stamps: small JSON files in its data folder's addons/ folder, each a word it stamps on a text
